2122. Counting Positive, Negative, and Zero Values Among N Numbers

80

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a count N followed by N integers, and count how many of them are positive, negative, or zero, using a loop combined with an if-else-if ladder.

Description
Read an integer N specifying how many values will follow. Use a for loop to read each of the N values one at a time. Inside the loop, use an if-else-if ladder to classify the current value as positive, negative, or zero, and increase the corresponding counter. After the loop ends, print the three counts.
input_spec: An integer N, followed by N integers, all separated by spaces.
output_spec: Print the count of positive numbers, then negative numbers, then zeros, each on its own line.
